envelope_request.name: TR1PhysicalTransitionV1
envelope_request.purpose: one common E1-E5 envelope for R4 and R6, with route-specific arithmetic payloads if necessary
envelope_request.deterministic_factor_rule: evaluate written whole-divisor terminal predicates in fixed order; after all miss, select the least prime factor of verified D_star
forbidden_inputs: cached family owner as an E3 proof
bare divisibility q divides D_star without an occurrence receipt
local checkpoint rank as parent-to-final E5

target_shapes.mark_behavior: root equation terminal; no recursive mark
target_shapes.admission_requirement: terminal verifier replays the explicit Type I or Type II certificate

target_shapes.existing_family_match: one existing Type-I family selected from raw target facts by common admission
target_shapes.mark_behavior: preserve ROOT_SOL only if a universal identity lift is proved
target_shapes.T5_ticket_type: LOCAL_DROP or PHASE_DROP, derived from the actual parent and final target
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: none; common classifier must determine the owner from raw target facts
target_shapes.admission_requirement: target passes the frozen common extractor, owner classifier, producer target declaration and queue gate

target_shapes.existing_family_match: an existing low Type-I absorb owner selected from raw target facts by common admission
target_shapes.mark_behavior: preserve ROOT_SOL only if a universal identity lift is proved
target_shapes.T5_ticket_type: TYPEI protocol drop CHARGED to ABSORB when target support M is at most B_p
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: coordinator must expose the existing ABSORB owner in the frozen common grammar if not already representable
target_shapes.admission_requirement: target is a verified low Type-I chart, the protocol commit is irreversible, and common admission accepts its owner

target_shapes.mark_behavior: NONTRIVIAL_MARK bound to a strictly smaller equation rank and a universal Sol(n) to Sol(p) lift
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: use existing generic-marked precedence only after mark receipt verification
target_shapes.admission_requirement: strictly smaller positive equation rank, content-addressed mark receipt, universal lift and common queue admission

activation_gates: symbolic exhaustive partition with no explicit residual
coordinator approval at target-shape and grammar gates
